get.description: Requires catalog.write. The twenty-five newest jobs, newest first — enough for the drawer to show what happened last, not a history. A job records its outcome (done, failed, or blocked by Amazon's robot check) and every warning the import raised along the way.

post.summary: Import a product from an Amazon listing
post.description: Requires catalog.write. Starts a job and answers 202 at once; poll the job for progress. The job opens the URL in a real Chrome, reads the listing and each variation's own page, rewrites the copy with Claude when a key is configured, adjusts the pictures, and creates the product — as a draft unless told otherwise. Prices cross only when the marketplace sells in the store's currency; otherwise price_minor sets every variant, or none is set and the job says so.

url.description: An Amazon product page — any marketplace, /dp/ or /gp/product/.

max_variants.description: How many variation pages to visit. The rest are created with the parent's price and pictures.

price_minor.description: A price for every variant, in the store's currency — the way to import from a marketplace that sells in another.

get.description: Requires catalog.write. While running, step and message say where it is; once finished, status is done, failed or blocked, product_id names what was created, and warnings lists everything worth reading before publishing.

ImportAmazonImageOptions.description: What to do to every picture. The defaults are a little lighter, a little more contrast, and mirrored — mirroring reverses any text in a picture.

brightness.description: Added to every channel as a fraction of full scale.

contrast.description: Scales distance from mid-grey; 1 leaves it alone.

step.description: While running: fetching, fetched, optimizing, images, creating.
